result:
I've built B09 (HUD event motion). Typecheck, token check, build and the full test suite all pass: 107 files, 732 tests, including the 8 new ones. The new AC tests fail on `main` because the `hud-motion` stages don't exist there. I opened the screenshots of the overtake stage and a race countdown and both match the S1–S2 mockup.

**What changed**
- **Position change:** the Pos panel bumps to ×1.12 (stamp, 160 ms). Its digit rolls up one digit height (snap, 120 ms) inside a box clipped with `clip-path`.
- **New lap:** the Lap panel stamps from ×1.18, its shadow landing from 6 px to the normal 3 px (stamp, 160 ms).
- **Timing in race time:** following the NEW BEST chip pattern, `race-ui.ts` records the race tick of each position or lap change and clears the motion 10 ticks later. The first sync after a reset only sets the starting values, so it never triggers a move. A second change inside the 10 ticks switches to a copy of the keyframes, which restarts the move.
- **Race entry:** a reset starts the entry through a single `enter()` function, so B08 can delay it later until its wipe clears. Pos, Lap, map, Time (with Best) and Pause slide down from above; then Steer left, Steer right, Brake and Gas slide up from below. Each uses slide 200 ms with snap easing, 40 ms apart. The entry ends at GO, so a resume never replays it.
- **Reduced motion:** all the new motion sits inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, so only the existing press sink remains.
- **Stages:** `stage.ts` gained `syncStage()` for pushing extra frames and an optional `laps` setting. The new `hud-motion.stage.ts` has these stages: overtake, overtake-done, new-lap, new-lap-done, steady, steady-twice, entry and resumed. They run a 3-lap race and connect real touch input, so a test can hold a control down. I had to set 3 laps because the first registered track (`bends`) has only 2.
- **Touch controls:** `touch-controls.ts` gained `enter()`, which also re-measures the touch zones once the slide ends.

The slide starts half a viewport (50vh) away, the smallest distance that clears every panel, including the map's bottom edge, on phone and desktop.

**Tests**
| AC | Test |
|---|---|
| AC1 | `tests/ui/hud-motion-events.test.ts`, overtake stage |
| AC2 | same file, steady and steady-twice stages |
| AC3 | same file, new-lap stage |
| AC4 | same file, overtake-done and new-lap-done stages |
| AC5 | `tests/ui/hud-motion-entry.test.ts`, the order, 0.2 s snap and 0 s…0.32 s delays |
| AC6 | same file, resumed stage |
| AC7 | `tests/ui/hud-motion-reduced.test.ts`, which checks the cut under `reduce` and, as the plan audit asked, real motion under `no-preference`. It also holds Accelerate under `reduce` and checks the press sink. |

The shared test helper is `tests/ui/hud-motion.ts`. Nothing in the spec's plan audit was listed under Supersedes, so I deleted nothing, and I didn't need a design request.
